Name: Quaint Living - Wildflowers
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center][img=center]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/16506/16506-1683719499-6592227.png[/img]

Daffodils and crocuses are nice, but what about daisies...?
What about primroses, bluebells, or lily of the valleys? [/center]

[line][b]FEATURES [/b][line][color=#00FF00][code]
[list]
[/code][/color][*] New forages
[*] New productions 
[*] New clothing items
[*] New decorative craftables 
[*] New letters, quests, and secret notes
[/list]
[line][b]FORAGES[/b][line]
List of the new wildflowers and where to find them: 
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Bee Orchid (Summer; Forest; Year 3)
[*] Black-eyed Susan (Fall; Bus Stop, Mountain)
[*] Bluebell (Spring; Forest)
[*] Coneflower (Fall; Town, Bus Stop)
[*] Cornflower (Summer; Backwoods, Forest Ranch)
[*] Dog Rose (Summer; Town, Bus Stop; Year 2)
[*] Firefly Crocus (Winter; Backwoods, Secret Woods; Year 2)
[*] Fleabane (Summer; Town, Bus Stop)
[*] Forget-Me-Not (Spring; Town Cemetery)
[*] Glory-of-the-Snow (Winter; Forest, Secret Woods)
[*] Harebell (Winter; Forest, Mountain)
[*] Hellebore (Winter; Backwoods, Secret Woods) 
[*] Lady's Slipper (Summer; Secret Woods)
[*] Lily-of-the-Valley (Spring; Forest, Secret Woods)
[*] Lisianthus (Fall; Railroad; Year 2)
[*] Liverleaf (Winter; Forest, Railroad; Year 2)
[*] Marsh Marigold (Spring; Forest)
[*] Meadow Buttercup (Summer; Forest)
[*] Primrose (Spring; Town, Bus Stop, Backwoods)
[*] Queen Anne's Lace (Summer; Town; Year 2)
[*] Sea Lavender (Fall; Town, Forest)
[*] Sundew (Fall; Forest, Secret Woods)
[*] Sweet Briar (Summer; Secret Woods)
[*] Sweet Violet (Spring; Mountain, Railroad)
[*] Wild Aster (Fall; Backwoods, Forest)
[*] Wild Daisy (Summer; Mountain, Railroad)
[*] Wild Foxglove (Fall; Forest, Backwoods)
[*] Winter Aconites (Winter; Town)
[*] Wood Anemone (Spring; Secret Woods; Year 2)
[/list][/spoiler]

[line][b]ARTISAN GOODS[/b][line]
List of new artisan good items added:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Doleful Flower Basket
[*] Rustic Flower Basket
[*] Sunny Flower Basket
[*] Apricitic Bouquet
[*] Regal Bouquet
[*] Steadfast Bouquet
[*] Tranquil Bouquet
[*] Wistful Bouquet
[*] Youthful Bouquet 
[*] Wildflower Mead [/spoiler] 
[/list]
The recipe for each item can be obtained in various ways through the gameplay, namely letters, quests, and secret notes. Here's a cheat sheet in case you aren't interested in waiting:
[spoiler]
Flower Baskets (Floral Workbench): 
[list]
[*] Doleful Flower Basket (Sweet Briar, Sea Lavender, Basket)
[*] Rustic Flower Basket (Forget-Me-Not (2), Lily-of-the-Valley, Basket)
[*] Sunny Flower Basket (Wild Daisy (5), Sunflower, Basket)
[/list]
Bouquets (Floral Workbench):

[list]
[*] Apricitic Bouquet (Hellebore (3), Holly (3))
[*] Regal Bouquet (Wild Aster (3), Fairy Rose (2))
[*] Steadfast Bouquet (Lisianthus (2), Amaranth (2))
[*] Tranquil Bouquet (Queen Anne's Lace (1), Fiddlehead Fern (3))
[*] Wistful Bouquet (Cornflower (3), Poppy (3), Meadow Buttercup (2))
[*] Youthful Bouquet (Primrose (2), Sweet Violet (3))
[/list]
Others (Keg):
[list]
[*] Wildflower Mead (Wildflower (2, edible, same kind & quality), Honey)
[/list]
Note:
Hold the first ingredient on the list when trying to interact with Floral Workbench.
[/spoiler]
These items can be crafted using Floral Workbench, obtained by shipping a certain amount of certain wildflowers. Fulfilling these requirements also unlock basket crafting recipe.
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Lily-of-the-Valley (10)
[*] Sweet Violet (10)
[/list][/spoiler]

[line][b]COOKING[/b][line]
List of recipes added and how to obtain them:
[spoiler] [list][*] Coneflower Tea 
[*] Lace Cocktail 
[*] Wildflower Salad 
[*] Wispy Angel Cake
[/list][/spoiler]

Most of these recipes are sent by vanilla NPCs when you have attained certain friendship points with them.  
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Coneflower Tea (Evelyn 6H) 
[*] Lace Cocktail (Gus 8H) 
[*] Wildflower Salad (Foraging lvl 4) 
[*] Wispy Angel Cake (Haley 6H) 
[/list][/spoiler]

[line][b]SHIRTS AND HATS[/b][line]
List of clothing items added and how to obtain them:
[*] 5 Male shirts
[*] 2 Female shirts
[*] 2 Seasonal flower crowns
[*] 1 Flower headpiece


Shirts are obtained from tailoring. Flower crowns are obtainable at the Hat Mouse shop.

Tailoring Recipes:
[spoiler]
[*] Dark Blue Suit (Lisianthus)
[*] Fairy Bell Top (Harebell)
[*] Fancy Vest (Dog Rose)
[*] Flowery Corset Top (Black-eyed Susan)
[*] Posh Blazer (Sundew)
[*] Rustic Suspender Shirt (Cornflower)
[*] Star Shirt (Bee Orchid)
[/spoiler]

[line][b]CRAFTABLES[/b][line]
List of craftables added and their unlock requirements:
[*] Basket (Flower Basket ingredient)
[*] Monkey Topiary (Foraging lvl 6)
[*] Mug Planter (Foraging lvl 2) 
[*] Potted Fern (Foraging lvl 3) 
[*] Snail Topiary (Foraging lvl 8)
[*] Swan Topiary (Foraging lvl 6)
[*] Wildflower Bucket (Foraging lvl 6
[*] Wildflower in a Boot (Foraging lvl 4)



[line][b]KNOWN ISSUES AND LIMITATIONS[/b][line]
[list]
[*]Baskets (craftable item) can be placed on the ground, but cannot be picked back up by normal ways using a hoe/axe, use bombs instead.
[*]Wildflower mead price is based on the input wildflower price, but when you pick several wildflower meads with different inputs (which means the price should differ) and they stack, the price will follow the first picked wildflower mead instead. I don't see any workaround for this except putting the input name on the output (ex. Wild Sweet Briar Mead or Sweer Briar Wildflower Mead) which feels convoluted.
[/list]
